intro.text: A darkeyed boy living in Urithiru.
A darkeyed boy in Urithiru who works for his father, the potter Alalan, and dreams of becoming a Windrunner.

items.text: Adin worked for his father, a potter, though his bowls often came out lopsided. Before the tower was invaded he fell down the stairs pretending to be a Windrunner, and Kaladin bandaged his ankle.
Hoping to earn a spren, Adin followed his father to a battle in the tower. He hid at first and joined the fight only after his father was wounded; both survived, saved by Dabbid and Kaladin.

appearance.text: Adin is a thirteen-year-old darkeyed boy.

personality.text: Adin is brave and hopes his courage will attract an honorspren. He glares at passing Regals when they aren't looking, and worries that any sign of weakness might scare off a spren.
